items.title: Nicki Parrott interviewed by Monk Rowe. Utica, New York, November 6, 2010 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: And so between me and Greg, we did most of Kenny’s gigs in the last couple of years. I loved playing with him.

ctx.x: Yep. Because we were taking about who to bring up to Hamilton.
You never caught me with Kenny.
